note: Clark County park on the Black River at the north edge of Greenwood: one small loop of sites in a mowed clearing, with a canoe landing, playgrounds and shelters. Generators are not normally allowed. --Claude
summary: County page, map, rates, off-season and rules pages read (WebTrac not opened; Greenwood is not reservable anyway). $30 electric (+$3 weekends/holidays), $26 Oct-Apr; walk-in only; nine sites in 2026 (outer loop, construction inside); vault toilets, water; ATV camping not allowed. Not waterfront confirmed (river ~140 m west through woods). Pin within ~35 m of the loop. No phone stored.
flags: SITES: stored 15 (derived, no source found) -> 9: the county map shows nine sites and the 2026 notice names the same nine as the only ones available during construction ('Campsites on the exterior of the campground road will be the only sites available').
STATUS: construction notice for 2026 (see above); camping stays open on the nine outer sites.
HOOKUPS: electric at every site, amperage not posted; nothing written for amps. No water/sewer at sites.

SEASON: the county runs May 1-Sept 30 as reservation season and Oct 1-Apr 30 as walk-in off-season with electric 'on'; it does not say Greenwood closes, and only four other parks are named as open through deer season. The stored inclusion_evidence's 'April-October' has no source on the current pages. Nothing written.
PHONE: stored none -> 715-743-5140 (Clark County Forestry and Parks office, the page's contact).
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed; the loop is ~140 m east of the Black River behind a wide wooded strip (Esri 300 m frame).
PIN 44.78359,-90.60456 is beside the loop (~35 m from its middle). Fine.
Inclusion: sites ~23 ft+ not stated; imagery shows trailers on the loop. Map says 'ATV Camping is not allowed'.
